title: Flight-Sim Emergency Procedure Reps
dataSources: Pilot logbook (`flightlog:entry`), avionics telemetry (`avionics:telemetry`), flight-sim sessions (`flightsim:session`), pre-flight checklists (`preflight:check`).
app: Pilot and flight-sim telemetry — electronic logbooks (ForeFlight, LogTen Pro), Stratux / GDL90 avionics receivers, and Microsoft Flight Simulator / X-Plane SimConnect sessions — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightsim:session scenario=emergency
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as reps, values(procedure) as procedures by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks whether emergency scenarios are being rehearsed consistently in the simulator.
value: Emergency procedures are exactly what repetition is for because you do not want novelty in the real event.
implementation: Label sim sessions by scenario and procedure; count weekly emergency repetitions in `index=personal`.
visualization: Weekly chart of emergency-procedure practice reps.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how often you are actually rehearsing emergency situations in the simulator instead of just ordinary flying.
